summary: A Discord investment group member received a DM from an X account impersonating the group operator with a one-character username difference. The victim joined a copy trading operation through nexanuity.com and sent $5000 before discovering withdrawals were not processed.
user_mistake: trusted an impersonated profile and deposited funds on the promoted platform
prevention: Compare the sender username character by character with the known account / Confirm independent withdrawal evidence before depositing funds
